changelog: Sales lead page: the estimated monthly value reads first like the trial end — once set it shows as text with Edit (pencil) and Remove side by side, and the form opens on Edit with Save/Cancel (`DealValuePanel`). Fixed: "Complete follow-up" cleared the follow-up on the click, so cancelling the interaction form lost it; the follow-up is now cleared only after the interaction is saved (`InteractionDraftRequest.onLogged`) (#3803).

en: The estimated monthly value now shows as plain text once set, with Edit and Remove next to it.
Fixed: cancelling the form after "Complete follow-up" no longer deletes the follow-up — it is closed only when you save the interaction.
tr: Tahmini aylık değer girildikten sonra düz metin olarak görünüyor; yanında Düzenle ve Tahmini kaldır var.
Düzeltildi: "Takibi tamamla"dan sonra formdan vazgeçince takip artık silinmiyor; yalnızca etkileşimi kaydettiğinde kapanıyor.
de: Der geschätzte Monatswert wird nach der Eingabe als Text angezeigt, mit Bearbeiten und Entfernen daneben.
Behoben: Wer nach „Wiedervorlage erledigen“ das Formular abbricht, verliert die Wiedervorlage nicht mehr — sie wird erst beim Speichern der Interaktion geschlossen.
